notes.title: August Update - (Hopefully) Final Demo version
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Finished up lots of features and graphical assests in preparation for the full release!



UI, Graphics, Controls:

Made some further modifications to UI surfaces, visual clarity should be generally better.

Improved font readability in general

Coven and Dungeon UI updated for more clarity

Added new and prettier sprites to lots of items like crafting materials.

Added settings for sensitivity and volume into the dungeon menu.

Added XBox controller function, only works in the dungeon right now, but I'll be working on extending it.

Added cooldown timer at the cursor so it's much easier to tell when a spell is available again.

Added Action popups for No Mana, Silenced, Rooted etc. status effects for clarity.

Tutorials:

I redid a lot of the tutorials to make them more digestable, as most people who gave up on the game did so because of the learning curve of the tutorials.

You can play a whole dungeon run as a tutorial element now with more precise explanations on game elements.

The Town "?" icon in the corner will now open quick tips on every UI panel with explanations on relevant game elements, instead of just opening the lexicon part of the library.



Gameplay:

Construct Amalgamation cooldown increased from 10 to 29. 

Ala'Ista'Ire's Coals now no longer apply Smitten to everybody.

Blessing of The Slayer now properly times out when appearing in Nature's Bounty drops.

Enslave Human roll chances modified so you receive Zombie resurrections more reliably.

Changed how many runes can be slotted into Ranged and Melee weapons.

Trisha's Sacrificial Glyph now protects all runes in both weapons, except for other Trisha's Sacrificial Glyphs.

notes.title: Update 1.06 - June
notes.content:
Visuals and UI:

Revamped Menu system for easier menu navigation

Added music volume slider to Settings menu

Added sound effects slider to Settings menu

Temporarily removed Colorblind Mode from Settings menu because I realised I’m dumb and know nothing about how to make a proper colorblind setup. This setting will be reenabled shortly as I actually prepare the game for a proper colorblind mode.

Added more uniform UI surfaces for better readability.

New graphical spell effects to better communicate Self and Character targeted spells.

New graphical effects for summoning spells.

New Player and Enemy Designs added.

Added a more readable base font for longer text bodies.

Reduced fog density on some dungeons a little, as it was sometimes hard to see characters.

 

GamePlay:

Fixed an issue where Bolt of the Archmagi would scale from compounding debuffs like Uru Malenazu and potentially deal over 100K damage.

Favor of Syl and Celestial Mending no longer scale Health Regen off of each other. This allowed for an immediate full heal for Beast Tag characters.

Fixed an issue where Flameform would sometimes not expire properly, leaving you in Fire Elemental form for the rest of the game.

Fiend characters will no longer get scaling heals from Vitae powerups generated by Feed, Consume or Devour.

Fixed manacost for Pool of Immortals, now it’s actually worth casting.

notes.title: HOTFIX: Demo UI update patch
notes.content:
I got many responses that navigation of some in game UI panels (inventory/divination pit/library etc.) can be confusing. This is a quick hotfix to add easier navigation options.
Thank you to everyone who notified me of the issue!
